tagline: Global consulting firm that unlocks human potential and drives organizational transformation by synchronizing strategy, operations, and talent to accelerate performance and fuel growth.
hero_kpi_rationale: Korn Ferry achieved a net margin of 9.0% in fiscal 2025 (Net income attributable to Korn Ferry of 246.1 million), demonstrating increasing profitability of its consulting model despite a complex economic environment. This indicator reflects operational efficiency and the company's ability to convert revenues into profit.

kpis.name: Net Income Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue that remains as net profit after all expenses, taxes, and interest.
kpis.description: Net margin of 9.0% in fiscal 2025 demonstrates efficient conversion of revenues into net profit, reflecting rigorous cost management and operational performance of the company.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of overall profitability and operational efficiency.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, amortization, and non-recurring items, expressed in millions of dollars.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA of 463.9 million in fiscal 2025 reflects solid operational performance before financial and tax considerations.
kpis.signal: Measures recurring operational performance and capacity to generate cash flows.

kpis.name: Fee Revenue from Multi-Solution Clients
kpis.explanation: Percentage of fee revenues derived from clients utilizing multiple Korn Ferry solutions.
kpis.description: More than 75% of fee revenues come from clients using multiple solutions, demonstrating strong vertical integration and improved revenue stability.
kpis.signal: Indicator of revenue diversification and depth of client relationships.

kpis.name: Marquee & Diamond Accounts Contribution
kpis.explanation: Percentage of consolidated fee revenues from the 350 Marquee and Diamond accounts.
kpis.description: The 350 Marquee and Diamond accounts represent 39% of consolidated fee revenues, more than double their contribution at program launch, reflecting success of strategic partnership strategy.
kpis.signal: Indicates revenue concentration among long-term strategic accounts and their growth.

kpis.name: Client Loyalty
kpis.explanation: Percentage of engagements delivered to clients who have used services during the prior three fiscal years.
kpis.description: More than 83% of engagements in fiscal 2025 were delivered to clients who have used services during the prior three fiscal years, demonstrating strong loyalty and durable relationships.
kpis.signal: Indicates client satisfaction and stability of existing client base.

kpis.name: Executive Search Engagement Clients
kpis.explanation: Number of clients who engaged executive search services during the fiscal year.
kpis.description: More than 3,700 executive search clients in fiscal 2025, including many of the largest and most prestigious public and private companies globally.
kpis.signal: Indicates reach and market penetration for executive search services.

kpis.name: Senior Executive Placements
kpis.explanation: Percentage of executive searches conducted for board-level, CEO, and other general management positions.
kpis.description: More than 80% of executive searches in fiscal 2025 were for board-level, CEO, and other general management positions, reflecting the company's high-end specialization.
kpis.signal: Indicates specialization and value of executive search services.

kpis.name: Foundational Assets Data Points
kpis.explanation: Cumulative number of proprietary data points collected by Korn Ferry to power its solutions.
kpis.description: 10 billion data points, combined with behavioral science and exclusive intellectual property, form the foundations enabling faster and smarter decisions at scale.
kpis.signal: Indicates depth of data and behavioral science supporting solutions.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Data Protection
risks.score_rationale: The company has invested in industry-recognized security tools, with a global security team led by an experienced executive with over 20 years of cybersecurity experience. However, operating with 10 billion sensitive data points, it remains exposed to significant cybersecurity risks.

risks.title: Regulation and Compliance
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a complex regulatory environment covering data protection, privacy, and data protection laws across more than 160 countries. Evolving regulatory requirements could increase compliance costs.

risks.title: Market Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive consulting market with numerous global players. Competition could exert pressure on pricing and market share.

risks.title: Economic Conditions and Service Demand
risks.score_rationale: Demand for consulting and talent services is sensitive to economic cycles. Global economic slowdowns, inflation, and geopolitical tensions could reduce client spending.

risks.title: Acquisition Integration and Organizational Disruptions
risks.score_rationale: The recent acquisition of Trilogy International creates risks of integration and organizational disruption that could affect performance and client relationships.

ai_positioning.summary: Korn Ferry mentions the use of AI and machine learning tools in its operational context, notably in the RPO platform for improving efficiency and quality of recruitment. However, the company does not position AI as a strategic growth driver or as a distinct client offering.
evidence: Advanced technology and AI-driven tools are used to enhance the platform to drive scale, efficiency, and quality in RPO services
Mention of 'our ability to enhance and develop new technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)' in risk factors
